summary: Morgan Stanley Direct Lending Fund filed an 8-K to disclose an amendment to its existing senior secured revolving credit agreement. The amendment extends the commitment termination date by approximately one year to April 23, 2030 and the maturity date to April 23, 2031. The registrant acted as borrower. No acquisition, divestiture, or special-situation event occurred; the filing solely reflects a routine debt facility modification without a change in ownership or corporate control. The filing is analogous to a routine credit facility amendment and does not warrant classification as a special situation.
